The '''Greater Hub Spaceport''' was a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] located on [[Phindar/Legends|Phindar]]. In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], it was attacked by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] as part of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
